name: Codebase Memory MCP
tagline: High-performance code intelligence — indexes any codebase into a persistent knowledge graph in milliseconds. 155 languages, sub-ms queries, 99% fewer tokens.
description: Codebase-Memory MCP is a structural analysis backend that builds and queries a knowledge graph of your codebase. Full-indexes an average repository in milliseconds, the Linux kernel (28M LOC, 75K files) in 3 minutes. 155 languages via vendored tree-sitter. 14 MCP tools: search, trace, architecture, impact analysis, Cypher queries, dead code detection, cross-service HTTP linking, ADR management. Single static binary, zero dependencies. 120x fewer tokens than file-by-file exploration. Built-in 3D graph visualization UI. Works with 11 coding agents.
author: DeusData
